links.outcome: Hallucination rate in radiograph reports, grounded hybrid LLMs versus ungrounded commercial LLMs
links.effect: Hybrid LLMs grounded in structured image-derived findings had 30 (DeepSeek R1) to 60 (Gemma 3) hallucinations; commercial LLMs hallucinated in 100% of reports.
links.quote: Commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek R1-cloud) exhibited hallucinations in 100% of reports.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid pipeline pairing a task-specific deep learning detector with locally hosted LLMs that convert structured JSON findings into reports

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a novel hybrid pipeline combining a YOLO object detection/segmentation model with various LLMs for dental radiography reporting on a retrospective dataset.
